items.title: Janis Siegel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 2015
items.q: The interviewee discusses Rahsaan Roland Kirk ('He was the man') immediately after the interviewer mentions Hubert Laws. There is no statement from the interviewee indicating a personal relationship with Hubert Laws.

ctx.x: Yes. And that was a relationship that I treasured. And I think we were just becoming really good friends when he passed, I mean just gone. One day here, next day gone.
Yeah, I learned of him sort of after the fact of records that I liked and then I started to see his name on this one and then Hubert Laws.
Yes. Well Rahsaan Roland Kirk. He was the man.
